startText:
╔══「 🎵 𝗪𝗘𝗟𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗘 𝗧𝗢 𝗟𝗔𝗬𝗔 」══╗

✨ **Hey %s!** I'm **Laya** 🎶

🌟 Your personal music vibe machine!
I can stream **YouTube**, **Radios**,
**Spotify**, **Live Streams** & more
directly in your group voice chat!

🎧 **Unique. Smooth. Unstoppable.**

🚀 Type `!help` to see all my moves!

💜 *Made with love — Laya Music* 🎼
╚══════════════════════╝
helpText:
╔══「 🎵 𝗟𝗔𝗬𝗔 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗗𝗦 」══╗

🟣 **GENERAL**
┣ `<prefix>ping` — Am I alive? 👀
┣ `<prefix>start` — Wake me up!
┗ `<prefix>help` — This menu!

🎵 **MUSIC**
┣ `<prefix>play` — Play a song/link
┣ `<prefix>radio` — Stream a live radio
┣ `<prefix>playlist` — Load a playlist
┣ `<prefix>skip` — Next track ⏭
┣ `<prefix>pause` — Freeze the beat ⏸
┣ `<prefix>resume` — Drop it again ▶️
┣ `<prefix>stop` — Kill the vibe 🛑
┗ `<prefix>loop` — Repeat forever 🔁

🔊 **AUDIO CONTROLS**
┣ `<prefix>mute` — Silence 🔇
┣ `<prefix>unmute` — Speak up 🔊
┗ `<prefix>mode` — Audio / Video 🎬

📋 **QUEUE**
┣ `<prefix>queue` — See the lineup
┣ `<prefix>shuffle` — Mix it up 🔀
┣ `<prefix>export` — Save queue 💾
┗ `<prefix>import` — Load queue 📂

⚙️ **SETTINGS**
┣ `<prefix>lang [code]` — Set language
┗ `<prefix>admins` — Admin-only mode

💜 *Laya Music — Vibe Different* 🎼
╚══════════════════════╝
